summary: The recorded base reproduces the GLM-4.7 non-streaming defect: repeated calls produce [0,0,0] and get_weather/search/get_weather produces [0,1,0]. At the exact candidate commit, the new regression tests, the complete TestGlm47MoeDetector class, and independent adversarial cases all pass with dense local call indices. The candidate is a narrow source fix to Glm47MoeDetector.detect_and_parse and fully resolves the detector and path reported by the original issue.

tests.what_was_measured: On the exact recorded base, direct Glm47MoeDetector.detect_and_parse calls returned [0,0,0] for three repeated get_weather calls and [0,1,0] for get_weather/search/get_weather instead of dense call positions. The imported module was /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/function_call/glm47_moe_detector.py.
At exact candidate commit efe036384e2b805fdacd493f51d539a85b5770eb, both candidate regressions passed, including repeated/mixed calls and filtering an unknown tool: 2 passed and 2 subtests passed.
At the exact candidate commit, the complete GLM-4.7 detector unit class passed: 14 passed and 2 subtests passed, covering existing non-streaming and streaming behavior.

Independent cases passed for five repeated calls, call order differing from request tool order, unknown tools at edges and between valid calls, and repeated no-argument calls interleaved with normal text. Every emitted call had dense indices 0..N-1 and retained its name and parameters.

gpu_execution_evidence: The reviewed contract is deterministic CPU-side parsing of an already generated string, so GPU execution would not add issue-specific evidence. The assigned device was detected as one AMD Instinct MI350X with gfx950:sramecc+:xnack- under torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015, but no GPU computation was run.
native_rebuild_evidence: The candidate diff changes only Python detector/test/report files and no native or FlyDSL C++ source. The tested detector loaded directly from /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/function_call/glm47_moe_detector.py, so no native rebuild was applicable.
remaining_limitations: No GLM-4.7 or GLM-5 weights were available or necessary for the deterministic parser contract, so model generation and HTTP serving were not exercised or claimed.

The similarly structured glm4_moe, deepseekv3, deepseekv31, deepseekv32, and gigachat3 detectors mentioned only in the issue scope note remain outside this candidate and were not qualified; they are not counterexamples to the specifically reported Glm47MoeDetector defect.
No native code changed, so native rebuild and ISA/compiler validation were not applicable.
